√krath 'be jubilant'
[present: krathati etc. ]
secondary: causative: krātháyati 
derivatives: kratha E.+ krathana E.+ krātha E. -krāthin E. krāthana C. 
A very doubtful group of derivatives, in meaning and connection.

√krand 'cry out'
present: [1.] krándati etc. V.+ krándate etc. -- klandate 
perfect: cakranda cakradé cakradat etc. 
aorist: -- [3.] acikradat etc. -- [4.] ákrān -- [5.] akrandīt 
[future: krandiṣyati kranditā ]
verbal: krandita kranditum 
secondary: intensive: kánikrand- kánikrad- kanikradyá- cākrand- -- desiderative: cikirandiṣa- -- causative: krandáyati etc. V.+ 
derivatives: kránda V.+ -krandin C. krándya V.B. klandá AV. krándana V.+ -krandanīya C. krandanú RV. krándas V. kanikradá B.

derivatives: kráma V.+ -kramin E.+ kramya C. krámaṇa V.+ -kramaṇīya E.+ -kramitavya E. -krāma B. -krāmin AV.B. -krāmya C. -krāmaṇa C. -krā́muka B. -krāṃti B.+ -krāṃtṛ E. caṅkrama AV.+ caṅkramaṇa S.+ -krāmayitavya C.
